title: AI Engineering Hub
summary: A large collection of AI engineering tutorials and agent-application examples covering LLMs, RAGs, and AI agents. One sub-project, sdv-mcp, is an MCP server that wraps SDV's HMASynthesizer to generate and evaluate synthetic multi-table data on demand for an AI agent.
evidence: sdv-mcp/tools.py: HMASynthesizer(metadata); synthesizer.fit(data); synthesizer.sample(scale=1); evaluate_quality imported
needs: repo appears to be a forked/duplicated 'AI Engineering Hub' collection; sdv-mcp is the only SDV-relevant sub-project
